# Pacific North Systems
> Custom software and automation for operations-heavy teams in Metro Vancouver.

## About
Pacific North Systems builds custom business software, workflow automation, dashboards, field tools, and AI-enabled systems for Canadian small and mid-size businesses. We focus on replacing manual data entry, connecting disconnected tools, and building software that fits how teams actually work.
